policy.unsafe_partial: Official Replay skips unsafe and partial declarations; none occur in the conservative endpoint type/proof closure
policy.duplicates: Official Replay may reuse a previously imported matching theorem with the same name/type/levels/mutual-block metadata without rechecking another duplicate body
policy.axioms: Kernel admits axiom declarations in imported libraries; accepted endpoint dependency closure is explicitly limited to propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound
policy.predecessors: Every imported module in all frozen object-header parts must have a successful exact-module receipt before its dependent; no external source or kernel success inferred from caches alone
